label: 10-Year Wealth
topic_keyword: Stocks that turned 1 lakh into 1 crore
title: ₹1 lakh became *₹1.4 crore+* in 10 years. Only *2 stocks* did it

slides.headline: The *10-year* test
points: We checked every stock in today's Nifty 500 and Nifty Microcap 250.
Question: which turned ₹1 lakh into ₹1 crore or more from 20 Nov 2016 to 20 Nov 2026?
That needs a 100x rise. Only 2 stocks made it.
Price change only, split and bonus adjusted. Dividends not included.

slides.headline: The *2 stocks*: ₹1 lakh became
slides.note: About 64% a year, compounded, for 10 years.

slides.headline: *Cupid*: 148.8x
points: Makes male and female condoms and personal-care products; supplies female condoms to Brazil.
Q3 FY26 revenue: ₹93.51 crore, up from ₹46.35 crore a year earlier (+101.7%).
Share count grew a lot: 10:1 split and 1:1 bonus in April 2024, 4:1 bonus in March 2026.
The stock rose over 565% in 2025 alone.

slides.headline: *Tips Music*: 138.9x
points: One of India's leading music labels (formerly Tips Industries).
10:1 stock split in April 2023.
Very high returns on equity: about 85.6% ROE and 53.6% net profit margin.
Promoters hold about 64% of the company.

slides.headline: Why *holding* is the hard part
points: In 2025, Tips Music fell about 40.5%: from a 52-week high of ₹811.65 to a low of ₹483.
Selling near the low meant missing the recovery: by 11 Nov 2026 it was back at ₹774.40.
After a 565% rally in one year, like Cupid's in 2025, selling feels like the obvious move.
A 100x needs you to sit through falls and big profits without selling.

slides.headline: How *compounding* builds it
slides.sub: ₹1 lakh at 64.9% a year (Cupid's 10-year pace), steady growth
slides.note: Illustration of steady compounding, not the stock's actual path. Over 60% of the money came in the last 2 years.

slides.headline: What to *take away*
points: Big wealth comes late: at this pace money doubles about every 1.4 years, so the final years add the most.
The road is never smooth: deep falls and sharp rallies both tempt you to sell.
100x is very rare: only 2 stocks in this scan did it.
Past returns are history, not a guide to the future. This is not a recommendation.

headline: Stocks that turned 1 lakh into 1 crore in 10 years: only 2 made it
paras: We checked every stock in today's Nifty 500 and Nifty Microcap 250 for a 100x rise between 20 Nov 2016 and 20 Nov 2026. Only 2 stocks turned ₹1 lakh into more than ₹1 crore.

Cupid: 148.8x, ₹1 lakh became ₹1.49 cr.
Tips Music: 138.9x, ₹1 lakh became ₹1.39 cr.

The hard part was holding. Tips Music fell about 40.5% in 2025, from ₹811.65 to ₹483, before recovering to ₹774.40 by 11 Nov 2026. Cupid rose over 565% in 2025 alone, the kind of jump that tempts most people to sell early.
Compounding rewards time: at about 64.9% a year, money doubles roughly every 1.4 years, so most of the wealth arrives in the final years.
Price change only, split and bonus adjusted, dividends not included. Companies that were delisted or left these indices are not covered. Past returns are history, not a guide to the future.
